name: Doja Pre-Roll | Peach Tree
description:
Gelonade x (Gelato 41 x Afternoon Pineapple)

The nose of Peachtree starts off with zesty and sweet lemonade but quickly evolves into a full spectrum fruity flavor that when combined with the sugary citrus creates a smell that is similar to a ripe peach when in season. The taste is like juicy nectarines and Pine-Sol cleaner and the smoke leaves pleasant terpy tingle from the tongue to the nostrils. The effect is uplifting and is great for daytime use however the entourage of the terpenes and cannabinoids present create a strong cerebral effect.
